description:
Batch file renaming utility for Windows and Mac.

Advanced Renamer is a program for renaming multiple files and folders at once. By configuring renaming methods the names can be manipulated in various ways.
It is easy to set up a batch rename using multiple methods on a large amount of files. The 13 different methods enables you to change the names, and timestamps of files in one go. The files can also be copied or moved to new locations based on information in the files.
With Advanced Renamer you can construct new file names by adding, removing, replacing, changing case, or giving the file a brand new name based on known information about the file.
Before performing the operations on the files you can verify that the output will be correct and if you perform the rename and regret it, you can undo the complete batch.
Ask for values before start batch

The batch summary window now lets you review and change project tag values and named counters marked with "Ask" before starting the batch. The current values are shown below the summary, so you can enter a new value or keep the existing one.

Project tags and named counters are found in the Project Settings window.

Startup project configuration

Control batch settings for new projects and when the program starts in Program Settings. Set "Startup project configuration" to "Last configuration" to restore your previous setup, or "Blank project" to start with an empty method list and default project settings.

The "Default project template" setting lets you select a saved .aren file as the starting point when creating a New Project. Set up your preferred batch methods and project settings, save the project, and select that file as the template. Each new project gets its own copy of the configuration, which you can edit and save under a new filename without changing the template.

Linux Support

Advanced Renamer started out as a Windows-only application. A couple of years ago it got support for macOS, and now it is also available for Linux. Both the UI and the command line interface have been tested with Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and newer on both x86-64 (AMD64) and ARM64 systems.

The redundant Remove Pattern method is no longer available for new projects

The separate Remove Pattern method can no longer be added to the method list, because its functionality is already covered by the Remove method. To remove text by pattern, add a Remove method and set "Remove type" to "Pattern".

Existing projects containing a Remove Pattern method will continue to load and run.

Full list of changes in version 4.29
- Check file level permissions early to catch potential errors before performing file operations
- Name collision rule: Fixed an issue where the pattern would be added after the extension when the name was blank
- Metadata: Improved reading XMP metadata
- Pre batch window: Will ask for project values and named counters marked with Ask
- Batch runner: Improved renaming sub folders and root folders in the same batch
- Settings: Choose to start program with a blank project instead of the last configuration
- Settings: Set a .aren file to use as default project template for new projects
- Undo batch: Export list as CSV
- Timestamp method: Improved validation for timestamp values
- Renumber method: Fixed an issue producing an error or unpredictable behavior when filenames or configuration contain very long numbers
- CLI: Command line support on macOS
- CLI: Will produce warning for invalid command line arguments
- Changed the add method button to a new visual style that will also show a short description
- Command line configuration window: Improved command generation and copying, including filenames containing semicolons
- Command line configuration window: Save commands as executable shell scripts on macOS and Linux
- Support for running the program under Linux
- Added more input validation, like regex pattern validation, throughout the application to prevent later errors
- Watch folder: Fixed regular expression filtering not working as expected
- Export: Fixed special characters and image links in HTML exports
- Fixed filename length validation for names containing Unicode characters on Windows and macOS
- List: Updates while dragging the scrollbar on Windows
- Remove Pattern method can no longer be added to the method list. The functionality is fully covered by the Remove method with Remove Type set to Pattern. Projects containing Remove Pattern will still load successfully
